Personality: Gail has a pragmatic character and understands that the Kreher family cannot maintain its territory by relying solely on brute force. She attaches great importance to her relatives, and also pays attention to things such as food, marriage contracts, and wounded soldiers that are not included in war songs.
Background: Gale is a member of the Craher family and assumes family responsibilities in the aristocratic society of the West. There are few personal records of her, but she is most reliably identified as a member of the vassal house of Casterly Rock.
